column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 02 (M23002): Asteria menyelidiki kastil tua.
# Tetap Inggris: Asteria, M4, Doll, Boojum, Neural cloud, Scorch Marks (nama efek).
(A few days ago, a massive sweep was conducted in this huge building.)
column2: (Beberapa hari lalu, penyisiran besar-besaran dilakukan di gedung raksasa ini.)

column1: (Furniture, old documents, and those precious experimental instruments... it's as if they were emptied out overnight.)
column2: (Perabot, dokumen lama, dan instrumen eksperimen berharga itu... seolah dikosongkan dalam semalam.)

column1: (The luxurious old castle, once burying countless secrets, is now nearly abandoned as those secrets have been completely excavated. Inside the massive building, only a few mechanical dolls remain, either left behind in a hurry or unable to function normally.)
column2: (Kastil tua mewah yang dulu memendam rahasia tak terhitung kini nyaris telantar setelah semua rahasia itu digali habis. Di dalam bangunan raksasa itu hanya tersisa beberapa boneka mekanis, entah tertinggal karena tergesa atau memang sudah tak berfungsi normal.)

column1: (So on this night, none of them noticed that someone had already slipped deep into the castle.)
column2: (Maka pada malam ini, tak satu pun dari mereka menyadari bahwa seseorang sudah menyelinap jauh ke dalam kastil.)

column1: An explosion...
column2: Sebuah ledakan...

column1: (Asteria touched the Scorch Marks on the old floor with her fingers.)
column2: (Asteria menyentuh Scorch Marks di lantai tua itu dengan jarinya.)

column1: (She was very familiar with this kind of mark, and could even deduce the full picture of what happened at that time through these few clues before her eyes.)
column2: (Dia sangat mengenal jenis bekas seperti ini, bahkan bisa merangkai gambaran utuh kejadian saat itu hanya dari beberapa petunjuk di depan matanya.)

column1: (A Doll initiated a self-destruct sequence here, but for some reason, had survived.)
column2: (Seorang Doll memicu urutan penghancuran diri di sini, tapi entah kenapa, selamat.)

column1: (And the reason she was able to survive was that someone rescued her.)
column2: (Dan alasan dia bisa selamat adalah karena seseorang menyelamatkannya.)

column1: (There's no doubt—he's the only one who'd throw himself into something like this without a second thought.)
column2: (Tidak diragukan lagi—hanya dia satu-satunya yang mau menerjunkan diri ke hal semacam itu tanpa berpikir dua kali.)

column1: Hmph, you're still as 'gentle' as before... Commander.
column2: Hmph, kau masih sama 'lembutnya' seperti dulu... Komandan.

column1: So gentle that no matter what happens, you always put your own safety last.
column2: Begitu lembut sampai apa pun yang terjadi, keselamatanmu sendiri selalu kaunomorduakan.

column1: (Asteria revealed a hint of a smile that even she herself didn't notice.)
column2: (Asteria memperlihatkan segaris senyum yang bahkan tidak dia sadari sendiri.)

column1: (Ten years have passed, and that person seems to not have changed at all.)
column2: (Sepuluh tahun berlalu, dan orang itu sepertinya tidak berubah sedikit pun.)

column1: (That courage, as always, never changing, dragged him into danger time and time again... yet he always faced everything he shouldn't have had to endure with a smile.)
column2: (Keberanian yang selalu sama, tidak pernah berubah itu, berkali-kali menyeretnya ke bahaya... tapi dia selalu menghadapi segala hal yang seharusnya tidak perlu dia tanggung dengan senyuman.)

column1: M4, you really chose a headache-inducing person...
column2: M4, kau benar-benar memilih orang yang bikin pusing...

column1: Throwing this kind of trouble to me... is really too much.
column2: Melemparkan repot seperti ini padaku... sungguh keterlaluan.

column1: But no matter what, this is your final choice...
column2: Tapi apa pun itu, ini pilihan terakhirmu...

column1: Before you return, I'll work a little harder and protect that person for you.
column2: Sebelum kau kembali, aku akan berusaha sedikit lebih keras dan menjaga orang itu untukmu.

column1: In... every world you can see.
column2: Di... setiap dunia yang bisa kaulihat.

column1: (Asteria followed the tracks left behind all the way forward.)
column2: (Asteria mengikuti jejak yang tertinggal itu terus ke depan.)

column1: (Before long, she found the other thing she'd come here for.)
column2: (Tak lama kemudian, dia menemukan hal lain yang menjadi tujuannya kemari.)

column1: (It was the thing she was both worried and eager to see.)
column2: (Itulah hal yang sekaligus dia cemaskan dan dia ingin lihat.)

column1: ...Yes, this is it...
column2: ...Ya, ini dia...

column1: (Although the scene had been cleaned up on a large scale, Asteria, relying on her unique sharpness, still identified that thing from the remaining clues.)
column2: (Meski lokasinya sudah dibersihkan besar-besaran, Asteria dengan ketajamannya yang khas tetap bisa mengenali benda itu dari sisa-sisa petunjuk.)

column1: (No... something's off.)
column2: (Tidak... ada yang janggal.)

column1: (She squatted down and approached the remaining tissue in the wall crack, adjusting her visual module, wanting to see more clearly.)
column2: (Dia berjongkok dan mendekati sisa jaringan di celah dinding, menyetel modul penglihatannya agar bisa melihat lebih jelas.)

column1: (The once vividly writhing chunk of tissue had now turned into something charred black, looking utterly lifeless.)
column2: (Gumpalan jaringan yang dulu menggeliat hidup kini berubah menjadi sesuatu yang hangus hitam, tampak sama sekali tak bernyawa.)

column1: (But clearly, "it" was still alive.)
column2: (Tapi jelas, "dia" masih hidup.)

column1: Has it become some kind of existence even more annoying than "Boojum" cells...
column2: Apa dia sudah jadi keberadaan yang lebih menyebalkan daripada sel "Boojum"...

column1: Hard to destroy, unable to die... reborn in countless cycles...
column2: Sulit dihancurkan, tak bisa mati... terlahir kembali dalam siklus tak berujung...

column1: What a disgusting creature.
column2: Makhluk yang menjijikkan.

column1: So M4, your message... did it mean this?
column2: Jadi M4, pesanmu itu... maksudnya ini?

column1: But even knowing what to do, it's impossible to completely eliminate the impact it brings...
column2: Tapi meski tahu harus berbuat apa, mustahil menghapus dampaknya sepenuhnya...

column1: And are you sure you want me to do this kind of thing...
column2: Dan apa kau yakin ingin aku melakukan hal semacam ini...

column1: (Although thinking this in her heart, Asteria still carefully picked up that piece of sample—a kind of 'fragment'.)
column2: (Meski hatinya berpikir begitu, Asteria tetap memungut sampel itu hati-hati—semacam 'serpihan'.)

column1: (She conducted a comprehensive scan of it, and then firmly stored the data in her Neural cloud.)
column2: (Dia memindainya secara menyeluruh, lalu menyimpan datanya rapat-rapat di Neural cloud miliknya.)

column1: Even without "her" will intervening, you shouldn't exist here.
column2: Bahkan tanpa campur tangan kehendak "dia" pun, kau tidak seharusnya ada di sini.

column1: (She looked at those air-dried tissue blocks. It seemed to have "sensed" something, the shriveled tissue wriggling and shrinking into a ball in her palm.)
column2: (Dia menatap bongkahan jaringan yang mengering itu. Sepertinya benda itu "merasakan" sesuatu, jaringan yang mengerut itu menggeliat dan meringkuk jadi bola di telapak tangannya.)

column1: Time to disappear.
column2: Saatnya lenyap.

column1: (After saying these words, a faint blue light flashes.)
column2: (Setelah kata-kata itu diucapkan, secercah cahaya biru berkelebat.)

column1: (Asteria stares expressionlessly at the black smoke rising into the air.)
column2: (Asteria menatap tanpa ekspresi ke arah asap hitam yang membubung ke udara.)

column1: (She turns around and, just as she did when infiltrating, silently leaves the old castle.)
column2: (Dia berbalik dan, sama seperti saat menyusup tadi, meninggalkan kastil tua itu tanpa suara.)
